name: skill-pilot
description: Adaptive task triage, grounded execution contracts, and local skill discovery for Antigravity and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive task triage, grounded handoffs, and local skill discovery.
interface.longDescription: Turns rough English or Vietnamese requests into grounded execution or single-block handoff contracts, discovers relevant skills across Antigravity, Codex, and local skill warehouses, and enforces evidence before claims.
defaultPrompt: Triage this task, find the best matching skills, and produce a grounded plan or execution.
Inspect the project rules and target files, then write a single grounded handoff prompt.
